### Customer-visible change

Describe what a person can do differently and which existing designs, artwork, journeys or handoff steps this affects.

### Verification

Link the release check for this revision. For a visual or behavior change, include the observed phone result and the relevant download, preservation or undo result.

### Protected changes

List each proposed removal, replacement of an Original or change to a safeguard. Record Blake’s explicit approval for each affected item before merge. If the change only adds a design or edits a copy, name the original that remains selectable.
